title: AI Production Planning Optimizer
short: Builds feasible production schedules that respect equipment, cleaning, staff and material constraints — and re-plans when something changes.
symptom: The production plan breaks every time something changes
directions: Load orders, capacities and constraints. Compare optimized schedule options and see the impact of each change before approving.
problem: Planners juggle demand, equipment availability, cleaning and changeover times, campaign rules, staff and material arrivals in spreadsheets; one delay can cascade through the whole plan.
why: Poor schedules mean idle equipment, excess changeovers, overtime and late deliveries — and ultimately shortages.
solution: Formulates scheduling as an optimization problem with GMP-relevant constraints (cleaning validation, campaign lengths, line clearance), generates alternative schedules and quickly re-plans when an order, machine or material changes.
data: Equipment capacity, cleaning and changeover times
limitations: Only as good as the constraint data entered
Unusual events still need planner judgment
review: The production planner reviews and approves every schedule before release to the floor.
